housing: Malvern Hills is a rural district centred on the Victorian spa town of Malvern, with the small towns of Upton-upon-Severn and Tenbury Wells and many villages. Most households own their homes, and the rented stock includes Victorian villas converted into flats, terraces in Malvern Link and rural cottages. Upton and Tenbury lie beside rivers that flood, and many rural homes are off mains gas.
checkinTips: Victorian villas converted into flats in Great Malvern: photograph communal stairs, fire doors, sash windows and any damp in basements.
Riverside homes in Upton-upon-Severn and Tenbury Wells: record floors, walls and skirting for flood marks or damp.
Stone cottages along the hills: note damp patches, condensation and the state of any wood burner and its flue.
Rural homes off mains gas: photograph the oil tank, its gauge level and the boiler service label.
Homes on steep hillside plots: photograph steps, retaining walls, paths and gutters at the start of the tenancy.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair or safety concerns can contact the private sector housing team that serves Malvern Hills and Wychavon through the council website.
